Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 5371 of 2023
Applicant :- Nand Kishor

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Vinod Kumar Singh,P.K. Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A.for the State. and perused the material on record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to direct the courts below to accept personal bond of the applicant and two bonds of sureties in one case and the same shall be treated to be good for all 19 Criminal Cases and further pleased to fix reasonable amount of personal bond and bonds of two sureties during the pendency of present case seeking a direction upon the court below to accept the personal bond and two sureties in one criminal case treating the same for all the 19 criminal cases as mentioned in paragraph no.5 of the affidavit accompanying the application.
The contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant is involved in 19 cases criminal cases for various offences, in which cases, the applicant has been granted bail.
He further submits that in all cases the applicant has been directed to furnish two sureties and bail bonds.
He next submits that the applicant is unable to manage the separate surety bonds, hence, he could not submit his bail bonds in all the cases.

Therefore, he has requested the learned court below concerned be directed to consider the sureties and personal bond in one case treating the same for all the nine case but the same has not been considered.

Learned counsel for the applicant has indicated the details of the aforesaid five cases in the memo of application, which are as under:-

sentences.text:
He further submits that Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @
Vikky vs. The State of U.P. vide order dated 29th October, 2018 passed in S.L.P (Crl.) No(s).
8914-8915 of 2018 has directed the learned court below to accept the sureties and personal bond in one case and treat the same for all other case, so the same benefit may also be extended to the applicant.
Learned Additional Government Advocate has not disputed the aforesaid legal position being settled by the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
Keeping in view the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties as well as in the light of Hon'ble Apex Court's order passed in Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vikky Vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh, passed in Petition(s) for Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.(s) 8914-8915/2018, it is directed that the applicant shall furnish sureties and personal bond as directed by the learned Court below in one case, which shall be considered by the Court concerned as sureties and bonds in all five cases for the purpose of releasing the applicant on bail.
